displayName: OCI-GENERAL-017: CVE-2026-8452 — NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway Exploitation
description:
Detects exploitation attempts targeting CVE-2026-8452: Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway contain an improper restriction of operations within the bounds of a memory buffer vulnerability which could lead to denial of service. . Product: NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: cve-2026-8452 — netscaler adc and netscaler gatewa

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_general_017", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%cve%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%2026%') AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%CVE-%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%exploit%') AND "value" > 0
